warnings: Feedback does not guarantee stability; closed-loop stability depends on plant, controller and implementation dynamics.
PID names do not specify tuning, realization, sampling, filtering, saturation handling or safety limits.
Transfer-function, state-space and frequency-domain assertions are model-scoped rather than statements that a physical plant literally is the model.
SISO formulas must not be generalized automatically to MIMO systems.
Performance metrics require explicit conventions (thresholds, tolerance bands, loop definitions).
Remote sources are catalogued but not embedded.
